passivas.descricao: Regenera carta de dano mais baixa no fim do combate se matou ao menos 1 oponente
Pode usar gifts Black Spiral Dancer, 7th Generation, Homid e Shadow Lords

_metadata.texto_original: Vladimir can automatically regenerate the lowest damage card at the end of any combat in which he killed at least 1 opponent. Vladimir can use Black Spiral Dancer, 7th Generation, Homid and Shadow Lords Gifts.
